POWER RESTORATION UPDATE
Affected Areas: 
Asdes-gonzaga feeder 1 = Restored at 7:05PM
Asdes-gonzaga feeder 2 = Restored at 8:45PM
Asdes-gonzaga feeder 3 = Restored at 5:01PM
Asdes-gonzaga feeder 4 = Restored at 4:12PM
Asdes-gonzaga feeder 5 = Restored at 3:59PM
Asdes-gonzaga feeder 7 = Restored at 2:50PM
We sincerely thank our valued consumers for your patience and continued support throughout the restoration process.
If you are still experiencing a power outage, kindly send us your account details and contact number so we can assist you as soon as possible. 
Thank you for your patience and understanding

POWER ADVISORY
UNSCHEDULED POWER INTERRUPTION 
Due to the activation of its protective equipment, Whole of Asdes-Gonzaga substation (AGF1, AGF2, AGF3, AGF4, AGF5, AGF7) automatically tripped off.
Reason: ongoing survey
Date/Time: October 3, 2026 (Saturday)/ 2:55 PM
Affected Areas:
